text_block_list.text:
Having cleared the Mainichi Okan, days of 
training followed in preparation for the 
next goal: the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... phew...!

"—Her race times were being broken day 
after day...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! She's getting faster and 
faster...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Still, somehow, it's a little...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, um...! Please don't push yourself 
too hard!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please don't worry. I'm having so 
much fun right now. So... I'm okay.

The days of training continued. Then, the 
day before the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was a wonderful bath~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Suzuka, that compress on your 
leg...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It hurts a little bit. So I figured I'd 
check, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? But tomorrow is...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. I can run.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, please hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...You want me to... withdraw from 
tomorrow's Tenno Sho (Autumn)...?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Suzuka-san is... unbelievably 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"A speed that never slackens no matter how 
far she runs... Just watching her takes my 
breath away."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But...! That's why I'm so anxious. Even 
now, my legs are...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please...! If you ever became unable to 
run, I'd...!
A heavy silence fell between the two.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan, you know...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I stand in a place I never 
could have reached alone.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's because Spe-chan and Trainer-san 
believed in me... that I'm surely able to 
stand in this place today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now... as we are now, I know 
we'll see an unbelievable view tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Just because of that...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
We Umamusume... won't be in our prime 
forever, after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If the current me is the "fastest me"...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The next race will be the fastest run of 
my entire life."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So... please, Spe-chan.

An Umamusume's peak doesn't last 
forever... Once their golden age ends, an 
athlete faces an inevitable, steady 
decline.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Something like that..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's not fair, Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Because, I mean...! There's no way I 
could ever stop you after seeing that...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Spe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Everything's going to be fine, I swear. 
Just trust me...!

“—Please make sure you come back.” With 
those words, Special Week saw Silence 
Suzuka off.
